messages:
maria_cs: ping — OliveBridge (trial account) just asked for a temporary cross-region egress allowance and a 4x rate window bump for a 48h demo. They also dropped feedback that latency to APAC regions is hurting the trial.

olivia_am: heads-up — renewal at risk if we don't show perf improvements + cost tuning. They're running a chat-heavy demo hitting ~120 rps bursts. Want APAC endpoints + IP allowlist so they can demo to local partners.

lina_eng: can we route their traffic to the apac edge pool and apply a temporary rate window change? what's their team id?

maria_cs: team_id olivebridge-7. customer supplied CIDRs: 198.51.100.0/24 and 203.0.113.56/32. need CORS + API key rotation note too — they will rotate keys midday tomorrow.

noah_sre: OK — from infra side we can add allowlist entries and create a routing policy to prefer apac-edge (priority=10) for that team. I need the exact time window.

maria_cs: request: start 2026-04-12 08:00 UTC, end 2026-04-14 08:00 UTC. rate window increment: from 60rpm to 240rpm per API key, burst allowance up to 400 for 30s.

lina_eng: noted. config snippet I'll push to staging policy:

```
policy {
  team: "olivebridge-7"
  route_preference: ["apac-edge", "global-edge"]
  temporary_overrides {
    rate_limit_per_key: "240/min"
    burst_limit: "400/30s"
    window_expires: "2026-04-14T08:00:00Z"
  }
  allowlist_cidrs: ["198.51.100.0/24", "203.0.113.56/32"]
}
```

lina_eng: I'll open a PR to infra-policy and tag @noah_sre for approval.

noah_sre: approve after we validate no conflicting global capacity reservations for that window. Also, we'll enable temporary logging at DEBUG for that team to capture latency metrics for the account health report.

maria_cs: perfect — could you also add a quick cost note for Olivia so we can discuss tradeoffs? customer cares about unit cost.

olivia_am: yes please. we should show them two scenarios: (1) apac-edge routing + caching hints (reduce token cost by ~15%) and (2) fallback to quantized smaller model on burst to keep latencies low — include projected monthly delta if this becomes permanent.

lina_eng: will add caching TTL suggestion and a recommended quantized model knob. I'll attach a sample prompt set and eval results after the demo so product can qualify quality delta.

maria_cs: customer asked to confirm CORS allowed origins list — they want to add https://demo.olivebridge.ai. Also asked how long IPs stay on allowlist after the window.

noah_sre: we'll auto-expire allowlist CIDRs at window end. I'll add a manual revoke link to the ticket so CS can revoke early if needed.

deploy-bot: deploy requested — infra-policy PR #4821 opened by lina_eng. Status: CI running.

lina_eng: CI green. @noah_sre please approve and I'll merge. After merge I'll trigger policy rollout to staging then prod with gradual canary (10% -> 50% -> 100%).

noah_sre: approved and merged. rolling out now. Canary at 10% — watching KPIs.

maria_cs: sending customer confirmation: "We have scheduled the APAC routing + temporary rate bump for 2026-04-12 08:00 UTC -> 2026-04-14 08:00 UTC. CIDRs will be auto-expired at window end. We'll capture latency and cost metrics during the demo and follow up with recommended longer-term settings. Note: rotating API keys midday tomorrow is fine; please post new key to the secure form." :thumbsup:

olivia_am: capture this in the renewal playbook as a pending action: if demo metrics improve by 10% latency or 12% cost savings, trigger outreach with discount + dedicated capacity offer.

maria_cs: noted. I'll add a short feedback capture form post-demo to gather qualitative notes from their partners (ease-of-use, perceived latency).

noah_sre: monitoring looks good so far on canary. latency to apac-edge improved ~220ms median for demo payloads. continuing to observe.

maria_cs: thanks team — I'll update the customer and close this loop after the demo ends.

olivia_am: documented in renewal tracker under olivebridge-7 (risk: medium -> mitigated if demo succeeds).

maria_cs: closing comments: good job. action items: lina add caching & quantization suggestions, noah ensure auto-revoke + logs, olivia prep renewal offer, maria send feedback form.
